name: fiendish_panda_offers_no_bear_no_six_not_itself
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature dies, return another target non-Bear creature card with mana value less than or equal to this creature's power from your graveyard to the battlefield.' Fiendish Panda (3/2, no counters) dies. Seat 0's graveyard holds two legal cards, non-Bear creature cards of mana value 3 and 2, and three that are not: a Bear creature card of mana value 2 (non-Bear), a creature card of mana value 4 (above its power 3) and a noncreature card; the opponent's graveyard holds a mana value 1 creature card (not your graveyard); the Panda itself is a Bear and 'another'. The step answers no target, so it stops at the target ask, which offers the two legal cards only: card:1 and card:2 are Grave Three and Grave Two, the setup's second and third cards.
